files.note: Checked agent_list: the blocking catalogue probe runs off the UI thread and a join failure falls back to an empty list; no panic or swallowed user-visible error in this thin wrapper.

Reviewed the idle-delay bounds, front_agent and quiet_enough checks, sleep_record's session bookkeeping and its writer; a refused sleep writes nothing and a missing or blank session is rejected. No defect proved.
Reviewed icon_choice/blur_on, variant's pixel maths and apply's per-window icon and effect calls; a refused effect would stop the loop, but that needs a real window to prove, so it is left unproven.

Reviewed mode parsing, want, the Windows SetThreadExecutionState hold and the Unix blocker lifecycle, plus step's retry backoff; the blocker is reaped on drop and a dead one is retaken. No defect proved.
Checked shown's cap, overlay_rgba's disc and digit bounds (every drawn pixel stays inside the 16x16 image) and badge_set's ignored platform failures; no bug found.

Reviewed forget_check/forget_verdict, the status list save (caller ids reserved before slugging, blank labels dropped, an unreadable list is an error) and dir_size's no-follow walk and budget; no defect proved.
Reviewed on/env_set and apply's Claude environment and Codex -c overrides, including the terminator and user-choice checks; the existing tests cover the edge cases and no boundary defect was found.
Checked parse_time and claude_dir. parse_time accepts impossible dates such as month 13, reported as R8-F02; the folder lookup correctly reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR before the home folder.

Reviewed front_of/decide, the seen_since clock map and find_loose's newest-since search; the clock is forgotten when the agent leaves and the loose search only takes transcripts written after the sighting. No defect proved.

Reviewed safe_name (reserved devices, trailing dots and spaces, 80-character cut), start's create_new counter loop, transcript copy/restore and list_past_chats' byte-checked stamp slicing; no defect proved.

Reviewed verified_copy's byte comparison, the OpenClipboard retry with CloseClipboard on drop, global-memory ownership when SetClipboardData refuses a block and the fixed 64-unit registry read; no reachable panic or leak proved.
Checked creature_name's bijective pair walk, its case-insensitive taken set and the never-ending candidate list; the expect is unreachable and no bug was found.

Reviewed scrub's masking rules (the no-space Authorization scheme leak is reported as R8-F03), the write-time mask and rotation caps, strip_home's boundary regex and scrub_bytes' UTF-8 handling; the other rules held.
Checked the WebView2 context-menu hook, the page-ready flag and the suggestion cap; an unready page or a read error leaves the engine's own menu alone. No defect proved.

Reviewed crash filtering by kind and shutdown, the in-flight dedup window, memory readings and the recovery record merge; a duplicate inside the window is merged rather than recorded twice. No defect proved.
Checked the KOLUX_ to KOLUX_RS_ fallback, new-name precedence and the refusal to fall back for names outside Kolux's prefix; no bug.
Reviewed the home-folder lookup, path/is_everyday comparison, folder creation and project reuse; a missing home returns a plain error and no Git repository is made. No defect proved.

Reviewed begin's one-shot flag, the per-step thread and deadline arithmetic, panic reporting and the line report; steps past the deadline are started but not waited for as documented. No defect proved.
Checked tidy_fonts' alias, blank and repeat handling and the PowerShell and fc-list command setup, including the hidden window and the empty-list error; no bug.
Reviewed bare's prefix normalisation, the retired-key list and without_retired/drop_retired; only exact old spellings are removed and live keys survive a load and a save. No defect proved.
Reviewed tidy_rel's absolute, `..`, .git and drive checks, the include and sharedDirectories scanners, the copy budget accounting and the junction fallback; no boundary defect proved.
Reviewed progress parsing, the WinGet exit-code table, the per-agent job and run guard, the timeout and the fresh PATH merge; the job map and view updates are run-guarded. No defect proved.
Checked compose's live-session join with the latest layout, placement field validation and the foreground fallback for typed agents; a stale layout row adds nothing. No bug.
Reviewed home lookup, empty-file creation, the per-platform write path and the parse-before-write rule; a broken file is left untouched and its parse error is shown. No defect proved.

Reviewed the command registration and startup wiring (badge, notifications, diagnostics, permissions and quit paths); the dev-only panic hook is behind an environment variable and not user-reachable. No defect proved.
Checked secret(): two independently keyed RandomState hashes give a 128-bit local token; no predictable value or shared state is involved.
Reviewed start/get, read's timeout and child kill and reap, and parse_env's mark and multi-line value handling; the reader thread ends when the child is killed. No defect proved.
Checked the --terminal-service dispatch and its exit code; the windowed path is a plain call into the library.
Reviewed the menu state sync, navigation and new-window URL checks and the platform menu builders; external addresses are rejected or opened in the browser as intended. No defect proved.
Reviewed listing_args, line's bullet, name and disabled parsing and parse_listing's all-or-nothing banner rule; a malformed row drops the whole listing as documented. No defect proved.
Reviewed safe_name's separators, emoji and Unicode names, dot collapsing and trailing trim. A double .lock suffix still leaves a name ending in .lock, reported as R8-F01.
Checked places and read_first's search order, the development source-tree fallback and the error that names every place it looked; no bug.
Reviewed toasts_off, Targets' capped dedup, notify_event and notification_clicked, the WAV/MP3/Ogg/FLAC head checks and the 10 MB sound read; no defect proved.
Reviewed the pinned variable names, the sealed-key read and blank handling, and pane_env's empty-key refusal; the key is never logged. No defect proved.
Reviewed ext_for, save_into's create_new counter and its empty and size refusals, and sweep's timestamp parse and 14-day cutoff; a failed write returns an error. No defect proved.
Reviewed parse_netstat and listening_row's locale-independent state test, deepest_workspace's boundary, rows_for's dedup and session walk, cap_external and the shared netstat cache; no defect proved.

Reviewed check_name's Windows refusals, start_repository's identity fallback, publish's gh errors and badge_with's visibility read. A failed locate or register leaves the new folder behind, but proving it needs a failing store, so it is unproven.
